title: Critical heap overflow found in libpng parser
content: Researchers disclosed a heap buffer overflow in libpng 1.6.x triggered by crafted PNG chunks. Patch released in 1.6.44. Severity is high; remote code execution is possible in apps decoding untrusted images.

title: New open-weights 7B model beats larger models on code benchmarks
content: The Foo-7B open-weights language model was released today, outperforming 13B models on HumanEval after training on curated code data.

title: Why we moved our billing service from Python to Rust
content: A write-up on rewriting a billing service in Rust: latency dropped 40 percent, memory use halved, and hiring got harder.
